name: Paper Doll
source:
Paper Doll is a fictional story about a teenage trans girl learning what it means to be a woman, told partly through a dress-up game.

[From [url=https://lilybelmira.itch.io/paper]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Paper Doll》讲述了一名跨性别少女逐渐理解身为女性意味着什么的虚构故事，其中一部分通过换装游戏的形式呈现。

[摘自[url=https://lilybelmira.itch.io/paper]itch.io[/url]]
